concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-adyen-docs-payment-methods-paybright-ios-component]] — 2026-09-15 PayBright iOS Redirect Component Sessions/Advanced guide with versioned component setup and capture/refund routes; source flags no-new-integration and request-example conflicts.
warnings: Guide's live-request instruction conflicts with its statement that Adyen accepts no new PayBright integrations.
CA request examples have blank currency or USD despite the overview's CA/CAD matrix.

The guide mentions capture delay or manual capture for partial capture, but says partial capture is unavailable with Customer Area automatic capture enabled; a delay alone does not establish eligibility.
